entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're finally awake.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Were you dreaming? You were talking[n]in your sleep about an "obligation to[n]reform," or something like that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, our master plan finally comes[n]into play today. Let's hurry and go to[n]school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we're going to pawn that[n]medal today.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, you can hear me, right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You don't have plans, do you? Come[n]help me out, instead of sleeping your[n]life away.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We do owe it to him...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...We'll just have to wait. Hurry down[n]and help him out.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're cleaning up today?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's further away than school, right? Hurry[n]up and get dressed so we won't be late.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, you're there, right? Come[n]downstairs.
It's morning, and Morgana still isn't[n]back... I wonder where he went...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, it's your day off, right? I could use[n]some help.
It seems I'll spend today[n]helping out at Leblanc.
Today is the last day of[n]my make up classes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These classes are to make up the work[n]you missed because of the Kamoshida[n]incident, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's a lot I want to say, but I think it's[n]best if I waited till everyone is here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Gather everyone at the hideout after[n]school.
I should hurry to school...
I can hear noises from downstairs...[n]It seems Sojiro is opening the café.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, your friends are here. Hurry down.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddup!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Today's the day we're having Futaba[n]try and help out at the café, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This will be a stressful turn of events...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just one more day to go! Tomorrow,[n]we hit the beach!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, are you there? Sorry, but I need[n]your help with the dishes.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Help with the disheees!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is Futaba here, too?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That means we're not only helping out[n]at the café, but we're also babysitting[n]Futaba today too...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, the faster we get started, the[n]faster we'll finish!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, we need to talk. Come downstairs.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Come downstaaairs!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What is it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you're going back to school today.[n]How does it feel?
I'm happy to be back.
I don't want to be late.
I wish I had a longer break.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see. I find it surprising to hear that[n]you missed school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're right. Let's hurry and get ready[n]to go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, don't say that. This is better[n]than living in hiding, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, this is no time to be chatting.[n]You can't be late on the first day back.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, let's go to school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't believe you have a test as soon[n]as you come back... I guess you really[n]are unlucky.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, what should I say now...[n]Um, good luck!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is the last big heist for the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You and everyone else... You've all[n]grown so much...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, this is no time to get sentimental.[n]We're going to end this with a bang!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It looks like tomorrow's the deadline...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's your plan? We don't have[n]that much time left...
